title: Sunday · the Rain, 2014
logline: Seventeenth January. The alley wet-on-wet, the window with three jars and the dog at fifteen asleep under the table, and the motel from the lot with the line beneath. The last Rain with the first dog.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the alley behind the tavern in January rain, wet-on-wet, the beer sign in the puddle.

image.prompt: a gravel alley behind a tavern in January rain painted wet-on-wet with a beer sign's neon in a puddle, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Alley

panels.composition: Tier 2: the casement window from inside: three jars, the rain, and under the drafting table an old dog asleep on a blanket.

image.prompt: a garage window in January rain from inside with three jars on the sill and an old dog asleep on a blanket beneath a drafting table, watercolor

panels.name: Under

panels.composition: Tier 3: the motel from the lot at 3 AM, the office lit, a shape at the desk, a thin line under the tier.

image.prompt: a small motel seen from its lot at three in the morning with only the office lit and the shape of a man at the desk, a thin horizontal line beneath the image, watercolor

panels.name: Motel

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: The last Rain with the first dog.
